title: 获取字母数量
problem_statement_md: 编写一个函数，将一个字符串和一个字母作为参数，并输出该字符串中此字母的数量。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Letter Count[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Write a function that takes a string and a letter as its arguments and returns the count of the letter in the string.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
hello, how are you?
o

[b]Sample Output[/b]
3

[b]Explanation[/b]: The letter [b]o[/b] appears [b]3[/b] times in the given text.

[note]The given code takes the string and letter from input and passes them to the [b]letter_count[/b]() function. Define the function, so that the given code works as expected.[/note]
